The PVB_37 challenge (commitment 2) was ruled invalid and cost a $50 bond, even though 2629.4 kW declared exceeds the 2435 kW nameplate. I can't see why the server rejected it, so I won't re-challenge. Per the instructions, I did not challenge PVB_17 (5454.6 vs 5455) or PVB_32 (3274.8 vs 3275), which are at or below nameplate. I also did not challenge PVB_50 (6837.4 vs 6837), which exceeds nameplate by only 0.4 kW, which looks like rounding rather than a false claim.
